title: Remove CPEs that name unrelated products with the same name
author: wolfv
source: Remove CPEs that the automated CPE pipeline attached to unrelated products sharing a conda package's name. Found on basilisk staging, where these CPEs produced NVD matches on the latest release of each package. Package identities come from mappings/auto.json (primary PURL, source URL and summary). afterimage is libAfterImage built from the ROOT source archive; ROOT's CVEs (rootd daemon, bundled zlib) are not in this library, and shared source is not identity; drop cern:root and root:root. ark is posit-dev/ark, an R kernel; kde:ark is the KDE archive manager. bayesian-analysis-toolkit is BAT, the Bayesian Analysis Toolkit (pkg:github/bat/bat); bat_project:bat is sharkdp/bat, the cat clone. elm is the Elm language compiler (pkg:github/elm/compiler); elm_development_group:elm is the Elm mail user agent. flock is discoteq/flock, a flock(1) file-locking utility; flock:flock is the Flock web browser and messaging app. go-tools builds golang.org/x/tools (pkg:github/golang/tools), not the Go toolchain; golang:go covers the Go compiler and standard library. helix is the Helix modal text editor (pkg:github/helix-editor/helix); apache:helix is Apache Helix. jive is the Tango Controls Jive database browser (gitlab.com/tango-controls/jive); jivesoftware:jive is Jive Software's collaboration platform. lancet is ioam/lancet, a Python job-launching tool; lancet_project:lancet is the duke-git/lancet Go utility library. libglx is built from libglvnd; cpe:2.3:a:x:libglx is X.Org libGLX. This repeats the 2026-10-30 traversaro removal, which 2026-11-02T07-00-53-039Z--cpe-pipeline--493dc.json reverted. libpq is the PostgreSQL client library built from postgresql-*.tar.bz2; libpq_project:libpq is the npm libpq binding. libsecp256k1 is bitcoin-core/secp256k1 (C); parity:libsecp256k1 is Parity's Rust crate of the same name. minuit2 is the standalone Minuit2 fitter built from the ROOT source archive; ROOT's CVEs do not apply to it; drop cern:root and root:root. minuit2_standalone is the standalone Minuit2 fitter built from the ROOT source archive; ROOT's CVEs do not apply to it; drop cern:root and root:root. moonshine is hgaiser/moonshine, a Rust streaming server for Moonlight clients; moonshine:moonshine is the MoonShine Laravel admin panel. nitro is the Nitro NITF imagery library (pkg:github/hobu/nitro); nitro:nitro is the UnJS Nitro server toolkit. osc is theimpostor/osc, an OSC52 clipboard tool; opensuse:osc is the openSUSE Build Service client. phlex is Framework-R-D/phlex, a data-processing framework; phlex:phlex is the Ruby view library. protoc-gen-go is the Go protobuf plugin (pkg:github/golang/protobuf); keep golang:protobuf and drop google:protobuf, which covers the C++/Java/Python runtimes. sage is SageMath or one of its data packages; sage:sage names unrelated software called Sage, such as the Sage RSS reader extension for Firefox (CVE-2006-4711). sagemath-db-conway-polynomials is SageMath or one of its data packages; sage:sage names unrelated software called Sage, such as the Sage RSS reader extension for Firefox (CVE-2006-4711). sagemath-db-elliptic-curves is SageMath or one of its data packages; sage:sage names unrelated software called Sage, such as the Sage RSS reader extension for Firefox (CVE-2006-4711). sagemath-db-graphs is SageMath or one of its data packages; sage:sage names unrelated software called Sage, such as the Sage RSS reader extension for Firefox (CVE-2006-4711). sagemath-db-polytopes is SageMath or one of its data packages; sage:sage names unrelated software called Sage, such as the Sage RSS reader extension for Firefox (CVE-2006-4711). sagemath-sirocco is SageMath or one of its data packages; sage:sage names unrelated software called Sage, such as the Sage RSS reader extension for Firefox (CVE-2006-4711). sendme is n0-computer/sendme, a file-transfer tool; sendme_project:sendme is an Ethereum token contract. turbopack-cli is the Turbopack bundler CLI built from the next.js repository; Next.js framework/server CVEs are not in the CLI. vmd is Visual Molecular Dynamics from UIUC; vmd_project:vmd is the yoshuawuyts/vmd Markdown previewer. NVD CVE API 2.0 virtualMatchString counts on 2026-11-14: cpe:2.3:a:apache:helix matches 4 CVEs (e.g. CVE-2022-47500, CVE-2023-38647); cpe:2.3:a:bat_project:bat matches 1 CVEs (e.g. CVE-2021-36753); cpe:2.3:a:cern:root matches 1 CVEs (e.g. CVE-2017-1000203); cpe:2.3:a:elm_development_group:elm matches 7 CVEs (e.g. CVE-1999-1184, CVE-1999-0114); cpe:2.3:a:flock:flock matches 5 CVEs (e.g. CVE-2006-6954, CVE-2009-3007); cpe:2.3:a:golang:go matches 174 CVEs (e.g. CVE-2014-7189, CVE-2015-8618); cpe:2.3:a:google:protobuf matches 5 CVEs (e.g. CVE-2015-5237, CVE-2021-22570); cpe:2.3:a:jivesoftware:jive matches 2 CVEs (e.g. CVE-2016-4334, CVE-2021-45968); cpe:2.3:a:kde:ark matches 4 CVEs (e.g. CVE-2011-2725, CVE-2017-5330); cpe:2.3:a:lancet_project:lancet matches 1 CVEs (e.g. CVE-2022-41920); cpe:2.3:a:libpq_project:libpq matches 1 CVEs (e.g. CVE-2022-25852); cpe:2.3:a:moonshine:moonshine matches 3 CVEs (e.g. CVE-2025-51487, CVE-2025-51488); cpe:2.3:a:nitro:nitro matches 2 CVEs (e.g. CVE-2026-44372, CVE-2026-44373); cpe:2.3:a:opensuse:osc matches 2 CVEs (e.g. CVE-2012-1095, CVE-2019-3681); cpe:2.3:a:parity:libsecp256k1 matches 3 CVEs (e.g. CVE-2019-20399, CVE-2019-25003); cpe:2.3:a:phlex:phlex matches 1 CVEs (e.g. CVE-2024-28199); cpe:2.3:a:root:root matches 2 CVEs (e.g. CVE-2010-3376, CVE-2026-24811); cpe:2.3:a:sage:sage matches 5 CVEs (e.g. CVE-2003-1242, CVE-2003-1243); cpe:2.3:a:sendme_project:sendme matches 1 CVEs (e.g. CVE-2018-13598); cpe:2.3:a:vercel:next.js matches 63 CVEs (e.g. CVE-2020-15242, CVE-2021-37699); cpe:2.3:a:vmd_project:vmd matches 1 CVEs (e.g. CVE-2021-33041); cpe:2.3:a:x:libglx matches 1 CVEs (e.g. CVE-2013-1993). Each entry replaces only the package's CPE list; PURL fields and alternatives are unchanged. No replacement CPE is inferred.
